We fear our parents and we cannot do anything without their permission. We have to ask everything from our father through our mother that is why our freedom and power is low. In the past years there were no organizations which helped to protect the rights of girls even asking for anything was very difficult. But now there are organizations where we can report to if we don’t have freedom. At least we can make few decisions on our own.

Education is very important because I want to be educated but because of school fees I may not progress. Education is the future for everyone because you learn what you don’t know. However another girl said that “I want to be educated but I am not that intelligent because if we are educated, we can bring development help our village”. If I am educated enough I will be a Member of Parliament and I will help develop my area. A girl who is educated is responsible for herself. Education is good because you are able to find your needs when you are employed”.
Many boys in this community drop out of school in standard 8 while girls dropout in standard 6.

If you stop school at the primary school you cannot be employed but when you reach college you can be employed, therefore, it is good to reach college. Boys and girls should go to college so that they could be able to find good jobs.

Parents are not committed to educate their daughters because they say to educate a girl child is useless, a girl child will get married early. If a girl child sits for her primary school leaving certificate by the time results come out, she is found pregnant, so the parents are disappointed and that is why they don’t commit girl children to school.
Some of the agricultural activities that young girls do in this community are ridging, applying fertilizer, wedding, harvesting, banking, planting seeds and shelling either maize or groundnuts.

Reasons for ending education
• We do not know the purpose of going to school
• Early marriages
• Early pregnancies
• Lack of school fees
• Parents tell them to help with farm and household chores like cooking faming, taking care of little children .
• Lack of role models in the community
• Lack of basic needs such as soap

Two most important reasons
• We do not know the purpose of going to school
• Early pregnancies.
As for me I want to become a nurse after I finish school’
I want to become a police officer after I finish school.
I would like to be a president.
I would like to be Member of Parliament.
Most of the girls get married when they stop schooling and some practice prostitution and very few do business. Some help their parents with farming.

Girls should be doing business so that what they learnt in class could be put to use and some should get married. While those who get good education qualification should go to find paid jobs in towns.

They do not follow because these days there is what they call gender and sometimes young people especially boys try to help mothers to wash plates and draw water. Though it is easier for boys to help mothers than girls to help fathers because many fathers seem not to embrace gender.
Lack of plots to cultivate because the plots are for parents. Some parents do not allow their children to have a plot of their own. Where land is allocated to boys then there is no problem
They would face no problems as long as the crop was grown on their plot

At the beginning of each season, parents make decision on who farms on which plot. However, groundnut plot may be managed by women more than men. They look at the plot and if the plot is big it is shared to boys and girls and during to planting, we plant together starting with one plot till all plots are finished.

If the parents have shared the plot to the children then they (young ones) have to work on their plot and their parent’s plots. It is like they have borrowed the plots and some of the plots may be very far away from the home.

Some plots have sand soil while others have clay soil. Parents would share the sand soil plots to the young ones and the problem is that groundnuts from the sand soil is not good than from the clay soil that is why parents prefer the clay soils. There is no difference between boys and girls

The husband goes to his wife plot when he wants while women work frequently on their husband’s plots because they know that they eat together. For groundnuts women have their plots while men have their plots.

Girls would ask their parents or boys to assist with the work. If they have some money, they can hire labor. Labor is always available in this community. There are groups of women and men who go around looking for ganyu. They can even do the work on credit and get paid after harvest. As girls, we are engaged in different responsibilities that interfere with farming activities and these include household chores, taking care of children, collecting water, caring for the sick and going to school.
In order to fill the labor requirement gap, female headed households sometimes consult relatives or hire labor.

They can consult the extension workers for advice. More importantly they consult their husbands if they are married because in most cases land belong to a man. Sometimes they can ask their friends if it is their first time to plant. Even the man asks the extension worker or someone who has been practicing this kind of farming.
Adam can refuse because he will think that Ana will not be responsible enough by joining a local group. Adam will be afraid that Ana will be selling vegetables on her own if she joins the group.
Adam will not feel good because Ana will control the money which is supposed to be controlled by him. Adam will not accept that idea because he believes that a woman cannot handle money.
It cannot happen because Adam will want his job to finish quickly. Adam is a man who ill treats the wife and cannot consider her to do less work.

The village will think that Mary ill-treats her husband, but some people in the village will think that it is a good thing because Mary is helping the family by selling her produce. Others would think that Mary controls her family that is why she is selling vegetables on her own.

The community will feel that mark is a silly man some would think that she adores his wife. The village will think Mark is under peat coat government, controlled by the wife and that she was given some love portion. But other people in the village will think Mark is a good husband.
Mark will be happy because his wife has money. Mark knows that the success of Mary is for the entire family. He will share the success of Mary.
That means there is no difference between women and men. Any job must shared equally not this is for women only like washing plates.
It is good because it makes work easy and fast boys and girls share work equally. There is no group that is favored between girls and boys and we work equally.

The decision will depend on the size of the family and the quantity of the crop. Diana would start consulting the husband and he has to agree otherwise a decision to eat or sell cannot be made by a wife alone. Likewise David should agree with the wife who ever starts. They would decide together but it is usually the wife who starts by asking the husband.
David is the one who controls the family. He is the head of the family

They can change depending on how they see it. If it is too demanding in terms of farm inputs, it may be difficult to make changes because the husband may likely deny the idea. But if the crop is more profitable, David will likely make the changes.

Because it is believed that women should wait for their husband to give permission or at least know what is happening.

Because a man can make decision on his own.
Yes she can go, but a married woman can not go without the husband knowledge because she is in the hands of the husband.
A married woman is under the control of the husband, She must always consult whatever she wants to do or wherever she goes.
It is difficult because other women they don’t know how to ride a bicycle. She should tell his husband.
